༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dgyes glu bde chen rdo rje'i gsang tshig ce+es bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dgyes glu bde chen rdo rje'i gsang tshig ca

ེ ེsa bya ba bzhugs/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dgyes glu bde chen rdo rje'i gsang tshig ces bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ / he he badz+ra mahā su kha/ a ho hūṃ e waṃ kā la tsakra/ gnas dag pa 'og min sku gsum gyi zhing 'dir/ /pha bla ma rdo rje sems dpal yi sgyu 'phrul/ /lus phung khams skye mched rnam dag gi lha tshogs// dpe grangs las 'das pa mkha' dbyings kun khyab bzhugs/ 1 /sku mtshan dpe gsal bkrag ye shes kyi rang snang*/ /gsung gzhom med rdo rje nā da yi sgra gdangs/ /thugs spros bral g.yo med bde chen gyi rdo rje/ /dus 'gags med rnam kun mchog ldan gyi rang gzugs/ 2 /byin brlabs kyi chu 'dzin lang long du 'khrigs te/ /dngos grub kyi char rgyun 'dzad med du 'bebs shing*/ /ma dag pa'i dngos snang chos dbyings su zim nas/ /snang srid kun dag pa rab 'byams su shar byung*/ 3 /a ho ho/ snod mtshan ldan bde skyong gi kā pa la ru/ /bcud sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i dam rdzas rgya che na/ /nang rigs lnga ye shes kyi rang bzhin las grub/ /zag med kyi ro brgya dang ldan pa'i tshogs 'khor/ 4 /phyi nang dang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa'i sprin phung*/ /kha dog dang dri ro sogs ci dgar 'char 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kun bde bas dgyes so/ /rnal 'byor kun zhen med du tshims par rol bas/ 5 /snang srid kun bde chen gyi rnam par shar zhing*/ /gtsang sme dang tha mal gyi snang ba yal song*/ /nyams dga' zhing bde drod kyi snang ba rab 'byams/ /dus 'gog med 'char ba yi dga' ston ngo mtshar/6/ he he/ pha bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen gyi drin las/ /lam zab mo rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la brten nas/ /blo kun rtog las rlung rta pho la zhon te/ /lus phung po sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor du gnas pa'i/ 7 /rtsa nyi khri'i grong khyer srang lam nas brgyud de//

ma dag pa'i snang ba sna tshogs su rgyu ba/ /dngos po kun bden med sgyu ma ru yal te/ /stong gzugs la mnyam sbyor ye shes kyi ngang nas/ 8 /srog thur dang rdor bzlas la sogs par sbyor bas/ /rtsa dbu mar a ma'i mkha' dbyings su zhugs nas/ /'khor lo drug 'gyur med bde ba yis khyab cing*/ /'khor 'das kun a ma'i rnam 'gyur du shes 'dug 9 /dhū tī ru nyi zla 'bar 'dzag gi snang bar// stong gzugs kyi dag snang bar 'byams su shar der/ /g.yo med kyi ye shes 'dzin med du sbyor bas/ /ma dag pa'i thig le rim bzhin du zad nas/ 10/'gyur med kyi thig le'i cha shas kun rdzogs shing*/ /rdo rje yi lam lnga myur ba ru bgrod nas/ /mthar thug gi sku bzhi'i dbang phyug tu 'gyur ba'i/ /rten 'brel de da lta 'di nyid nas 'grig song*/ 11 / zhes bya ba 'di nyid rnal 'byor ba rnams tshogs la rol ba'i dus su dbyangs snyan pos glu ru blangs te don la mos pa bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di dag yang rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor pa bla ma dbang mchog nas bskul ba bzhin/ thub bstan dge legs rgya mtshos tshig rtogs swa bar bris pa'o// // ༈ e ma ga na tsakra a la la ho/ a ho dga' 'o skyid do gsang sngags kyi gnas mchog /'dir tshogs rnal 'byor pho mo'i rang snang gi gzigs mor/ / spros bral stong nyid chos sku kun khyab kyi dbyings nas/ /sku dang zhing khams rab 'byams cig car du ngoms byung*/ /yi dam dpal mchog dus kyi 'khor lo <bde mchog 'khor lo sdom pa > yi lha tshogs/ /thabs shes bde stong 'gyur med dga' bde yi myos te/ /sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yi 'du tshogs/ /dam can chos skyong pra phab gzigs snang du phebs byung*/ /gzung 'dzin kun bral ye bzhugs bde gshegs kyi snying po/ /rtag chad mtha' bral don dam nges don gyi lta ba/ /ye gzhi sngags kyi gzhan stong dbu ma yi gsang gnad/

/bla ma dam pa'i man ngag kho na yis rtogs byung*/ /tshul 'di kun mkhyen dol po'i rang lugs kyi man ngag /da bar ma chad byin rlabs don brgyud kyi bka' drin/ /khams dbang dang mthun bsam med rnal 'byor gyi zab gsang*/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob pa'i khyad chos 'di a ho/ /gtsang sme'i spros tshogs ye dag kun khyab kyi dbyings su/ /rang byung stong gzugs rab 'byams 'bad med du ngoms shing*/ /nyams dang rtogs pa 'phel ba'i bsod nams kyi bya ba/ a ho ga na tsakra'i rten 'brel te 'grigs byung*/ /'di phyi'i phan bde rab ster zab mo yi chos mchog /zla bral theg mchog gzhan stong dbu ma yi lta ba/ /rang cag 'gro ba yongs kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skabs/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol ba'i 'dzam gling gi nor bu/ /'dir bzhugs rnal 'byor pho mo'i dga' chen gyi dus ston/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i gru char 'bad med du 'jo bas/ /sa dang lam gyi myu gu phang phung du ldem zhing*/ /sku bzhi'i 'bras bu 'gro kun 'bad med kyis 'tsho mdzad/ /dga' chen bde ba'i rab myos rang byung gi rdor glu/ /kun gyi rna bar 'ong ba'i rgyud mang gi rol mo/ /a ho rtogs pa 'phel ba'i cha rkyen gyi dga' ston/ /chos sku'i rgyal sa non pa'i rten 'brel te 'grigs so/ / zhes dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i < 'khor lo sdom pa'i > sgrub mchod kyi skabs su mkho bar mthong bas shar 'dzam thang bsam 'grub nor bu'i gling gi nye 'dabs su gnas pa blo~X bza~Xng cho~Xs 'phe~Xl bas bris pa'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dgyes glu zhes bya ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 226--PAGE 225-- PAGE 224 -
